content.prompt:

answer.worked:

content.prompt: Round the following to 3 s.f.

answer.worked:
Round the coefficient to the nearest hundredth. The next digit is $2$, so the hundredths digit stays unchanged.
$$\begin{aligned}2.302 &\approx 2.30\end{aligned}$$
Hence $2.30 \times 10^{2}$ (3 s.f.). The final zero is significant.

Round the coefficient to the nearest hundredth. The next digit is $7$, so round up.
$$\begin{aligned}4.897 &\approx 4.90\end{aligned}$$

Round the coefficient to the nearest hundredth. The next digit is $6$, so round up, carrying into the units digit.
$$\begin{aligned}3.996 &\approx 4.00\end{aligned}$$
Hence $4.00 \times 10^{6}$ (3 s.f.). Both final zeroes are significant.
